The '''88th Flight''' was a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the service of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:88th_Flight.png|thumb|left|240px|88th Flight activated on [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]].]]
[[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] of 88th Flight were marked with the [[Color/Legends|slate-gray]], blue and light-grey [[Color/Legends|colors]] of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], uniquely striped diagonally across the hull of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' [[Hull/Legends|hull plating]] to identify them apart from other vulture droid squadrons. [[Droid starfighter/Legends|Droid starfighters]] of the squadron were equipped with comparatively minimal defenses and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]],<ref name="SWPM" /> as well as [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], [[Discord missile/Legends|discord missiles]], and [[Energy torpedo/Legends|Energy torpedoes]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Vulture Droid|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWvehVultureDroid.asp}}</ref> They were provided with basic targeting and defensive systems.<ref name="SWPM" /> When grounded, 88th Flight droids were less maneuverable on land than in flight. However, units were able to redirect power not being used for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]] into weapons and shields, balancing their performance as ground assault units.<ref name="Ground">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=88th Flight Droid fighter (converted)|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw11a-gnd.jpg}}</ref>

Certain units of the squadron were upgraded for command operations, and were equipped with better targeting and shielding systems. These command units were marked with vertical yellow stripes on the fore and aft ends of their upper wings, identifying them apart from their subordinate squadron members.<ref name="Command">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=88th Flight Command Droid fighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw24a.jpg}}</ref>

==History==
===Mission to Skytop Station===
{{Main|Mission to Skytop Station/Legends}}

Units of the 88th Flight were present during the infiltration of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] squad led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. They were activated by [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] along with [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] to attack Skywalker and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] with them on the mission.<ref name="Duel" />

===Battle of Patitite Pattuna===
[[File:Artoo_sneaks_in_from_behind.png|thumb|250px|A member of the 88th Flight during the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Battle of Patitite Pattuna]].]]
{{Main|Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends}}

About [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the 88th Flight participated in an [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|ambush]] led by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. One of the squadron's vulture droids pursued a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]]&mdash;commandeered by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] escaping the destruction of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]&mdash;through the midst of the conflict and into [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna's]] atmosphere. The droid fighter scored a damaging hit on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]], only to be destroyed following an evasive maneuver performed by R2-D2. The rest of the squadron engaged in the battle assisted in the repulsion of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic forces]]&mdash;as well as the destruction of [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|Adi Gallia's flagship]]&mdash;resulting in the capture of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] by Grievous.<ref name="Nomads" />

==Behind the scenes==
On [[July]] [[July 26|26]], [[2008]], the 88th Flight was first represented as a miniature in the [[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|''Clone Wars'']] expansion of [[WizKids Games|WizKids's]] ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''. The squadron was then featured in [[Ambush]] in [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]], and in subsequent episodes of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, such as [[Duel of the Droids]] and [[Nomad Droids]] in [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|Season Four]]. The expansion also included representative 88th Flight Command units, which were elite members of the squadron marked with yellow stripes on their wing pods.<ref name="Command" />

Images of the vulture droid squadron were provided by Lucasfilm, Ltd., taken directly from episodes of the series to be printed by WizKids on styrene miniatures. As with other units in the game, the name 88th Flight was provided by Lucasfilm, Ltd. to WizKids to identify the squadron in the supplied episode images.<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=http://swpocketmodels.com/interview/ga_interview.html|text=The Official Star Wars PocketModels Community website: Meet the Designers (video interview)|archivedate=20170529171225}}</ref> The coloration and design of the units&mdash;as with other color and design schemes for other flights and squadrons&mdash;served to distinctly identify the unit apart from other squadrons. This was done to preview the material of the series to the public only just before the airing of episodes, giving fans supplemental information of characters and organizations outside of episode dialog. Such information concerning the series material was strictly protected by Lucasfilm until the time of distribution.<ref name="Developer">{{WebCite|url=http://swpocketmodels.com/forum/index.php?topic=4232|text=The Official Star Wars PocketModels Community website: Question for WizKids Arbitration Official|archivedate=20180625233745}}</ref>

Also on July 26, 2008, [[Hasbro]] released a "Vulture Droid" action vehicle for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''The Clone Wars'']] line of their Star Wars action figure toys.<ref name="Hasbro" />
